refnamediv.refpurpose: enable SQLite map spree and frag records

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Requires a valid SQLite database. Tracks the highest kill spree and total frags in a round for each map, saving at intermission and map shutdown. Warmup results are excluded. Disconnecting does not erase a round winner. Existing higher records are retained. Set to 0 to disable records.
Use /records in the console or !records in chat to display saved records. Use !stats [PLAYER] to display current round statistics for yourself or a player selected by name or slot.
